gootex_core_notes: v7: Check System Status shows each Doc's hidden mark (and whether the template is marked); clearer message when GOOTEX_TEMPLATE_URL is not set. v6: gooTeX only works in Docs started from your group's template (copies of papers are refused). In each gooTeX Doc and template: Extensions → Apps Script → Libraries → GooTeX_Core_Library → select version 7 → Save.
gootex_thin_client_notes: Replace Code.gs and Config.gs in your thin client with the latest version from GitHub
